name: kusum-beach-platform
description: Kusum Beach Resort Management Platform - Self-hosted PWA for drink inventory, POS, and staff management

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

author: Kusum Beach Resort
